image_title: Comparison of LLM-based and Template-based Methods
summary: The bar chart compares the average percentage per user for LLM-based and Template-based methods across various categories, including S-CAN, S-HOW, S-WHAT-IF, S-WHY-NOT, US-HOW, US-WHY, DIRECT, and FOLLOW-UP. The LLM-based method shows a significantly higher percentage in the S-CAN category, while the Template-based method leads in the US-HOW category. Other categories such as S-HOW, S-WHAT-IF, and US-WHY show varied performance between the two methods. The chart highlights differences in user engagement or effectiveness between the two approaches across these categories.
